name: Yamaki Rinji
source:
"What are you looking at, HUH! You wanna fight!? ORA!?"

This student is a bit of a delinquent who has the role of villager. Although roles regarding adventuring stand out, the majority of academy students are either "villagers", "merchants", or other non-combatant roles.
When he arrived in XR as a villager, however, he reacted differently from other students. He did not accept such a role and rose to be the head of the bandits on his own. 
It doesn't matter if he doesn't have any cool skills or if his base stats are disadvantageous. He just wants to rise to the top with his own power. That's all he cares about.　
He is a man of few words. Well, he is not very good at talking much at all, so he usually talks in very delinquent-style manner.

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Human
Height: 165 cm
Occupation: Villager
